notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
The major update brought about a new game mode - hardcore mode. (A game mode for hardcore gamers.) After dying you will return to the beginning of the scene. Therefore completing the game will be far more difficult. GOOD LUCK!

- Bugs are fixed with disappearance of savings
- Some storytelling chambers are corrected in one scene
- Colliders are adjusted in two scenes
- The position of energy shields are changed in the bottom of the screen

notes.title: Update
